recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if BR&R/UTG later changes the THO Research Study Status value set or explicitly retires the remaining core-local copy of the historical status code system/value set.
issue_request: FHIR-32314 was a Published/Persuasive R5 BR&R request to add not-yet-recruiting, recruiting, enrolling-by-invitation, active-but-not-recruiting, and terminated to the ResearchStudyStatus value set rather than creating a separate ClinicalTrial profile.
initial_application: Commit b8c08af2bfd5437fc17ff4bb83aad8a9682e96c6, titled "J# 36709 and J# 32314", added exactly those five concepts to source/researchstudy/codesystem-research-study-status.xml and updated the then-current ResearchStudy.currentState short code list. The commit is contained in the v5.0.0 tag.
additional_context: ResearchStudy remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later same-area work, including FHIR-33096 and FHIR-53697, changed the completed definition and moved ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state to the THO-defined Research Study Status value set with Preferred binding strength. The current THO CodeSystem/ValueSet also contains all five FHIR-32314 codes. Zulip exact searches found no conflicting discussion; Confluence only showed a BR&R WGM agenda listing the issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested code additions are already present in the active source and in the current externally bound THO terminology surface.

related_jiras.note: Later R5 correction in the same ResearchStudyStatus code system changed the completed definition and binding strength without removing the FHIR-32314 codes.
Later no-change decision clarified that ResearchStudy.status is publication status and study state is represented by ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state.
Moved ResearchStudy.progressStatus.state to the THO-defined Research Study Status value set with Preferred binding strength, making THO verification part of the current-source check.
